items.title: Justin Jefferson: Seven catches in Week 11 loss
items.text:
Jefferson caught seven of nine targets for 86 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

items.title: Mike Evans: Racks up 109 yards, TD in return
items.text:
Evans (Achilles) caught six of seven targets for 109 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Extends TD streak despite season-low yardage
items.text:
McCaffrey rushed 12 times for 49 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for 13 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.

items.title: J.J. McCarthy: Struggles with accuracy in win
items.text:
McCarthy completed 18 of 38 passes for 173 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and rushed seven times for 33 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.

items.title: Isaiah Likely: Limited to one catch in win
items.text:
Likely brought in one of three targets for 35 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
